results.title: Block Storage is now available - Latitude.sh
highlights:
# Block Storage is now available

October 6, 2026

Add storage when you need it without customizing or replacing your server. Create a volume, attach it to your server, and manage storage separately from compute.

Scale storage without scaling compute

- Persistent volumes — Keep your data independently from your server lifecycle.
- Scale independently — Add the storage capacity you need without changing your server.
- Attach to your servers — Create and manage volumes directly from Latitude.sh.
- $0.08/GB per month — Pay for the storage capacity you provision.

Available in 🇺🇸 Ashburn · 🇺🇸 New York · 🇺🇸 Chicago · 🇺🇸 Los Angeles · 🇬🇧 London · 🇯🇵 Tokyo

highlights:
# Terraform: Elastic IPs over BGP

October 5, 2026

You can now announce the same Elastic IP over BGP from up to 5 servers and public networks using Terraform Provider v4.6.0.

Build more resilient network setups, distribute traffic across multiple servers and manage it all as code.
